name: AWS cost and credits coverage report
description: Aggregates AWS spend per linked account across the organization, compares it against applied AWS credits, and flags services whose spend is not covered by any credit.

name: EC2 rightsizing report
description: Finds EC2 instances that are idle or underutilized based on CPU and network metrics and recommends downsizing or termination.

name: Reserved Instance and Savings Plan coverage report
description: Reports how much on-demand EC2 and RDS spend is covered by existing Reserved Instances or Savings Plans, and flags uncovered usage worth committing to.

name: Orphaned EBS volumes and stale snapshots cleanup
description: Finds unattached EBS volumes and snapshots past a retention threshold and removes them after confirming they are not referenced by an in-use AMI.
name: Unused Elastic IP cleanup
description: Finds Elastic IP addresses not associated with a running instance, NAT gateway, or load balancer, and releases them.
